preconditions.description: The number of test cases t must be between 1 and 10.
The number of ladders n and snakes m must each be between 1 and 15.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= start <= 99 and 1 <= end <= 100 for start, end in ladders + snakes)
preconditions.description: All ladder and snake start and end positions must be within the valid range of 1 to 100.

preconditions.expression: all(start != 1 and end != 100 for start, end in ladders + snakes)
preconditions.description: Neither square 1 nor square 100 can be the starting point of a ladder or snake.

postconditions.expression: stdout == '-1' if not reachable else True
postconditions.description: If the destination square 100 is not reachable, output -1.
If the destination square 100 is reachable, output the minimum number of rolls required.
